info.title: Metrics API
info.description:
The Metrics REST API version 2, available in the Neo environment, allows you to retrieve metrics for Java and HTML5 applications. Furthermore, you can get metrics of any database system as well as for SAP HANA XS applications. For more information, see [SAP Monitoring Service.](https://help.sap.com/docs/MONITORING_SERVICE/64f7d2b06c6b40a9b3097860c5930641/2dacf6f12dd047efad9bc8929ff1759d.html) 

To use this REST API, you first need to get OAuth client credentials (client ID and secret) by using the SAP BTP cockpit. You then pass the OAuth client credentials to the token endpoint to obtain an [access token](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6749#page-41). Finally, in the REST API request, you include the access token as a header. See [Using Platform APIs](https://help.sap.com/docs/BTP/ea72206b834e4ace9cd834feed6c0e09/392af9d162694d6595499f1549978aa6.html).
